# Malayalam ASR smoke fixture

`kaley.wav` is the Malayalam pronunciation **കാലേ** ("morning") recorded by
Adithyak1997 for Lingua Libre and published on Wikimedia Commons under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

- Source page: <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LL-Q36236_(mal)-Adithyak1997-%E0%B4%95%E0%B4%BE%E0%B4%B2%E0%B5%87.wav>
- Downloaded source: <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/LL-Q36236_(mal)-Adithyak1997-%E0%B4%95%E0%B4%BE%E0%B4%B2%E0%B5%87.wav>
- Reference transcript: `reference.txt`

The fixture is intentionally short and is used only to prove that the pinned
Malayalam model loads, returns Malayalam Unicode, and remains reasonably close
to its known transcript.
